summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised to 240 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, with year-end dividend increased by 30 yen to 135 yen, reflecting upward revision of earnings forecast and targeting dividend payout ratio of approximately 40%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Performance Forecast and Revision (Increase) of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
Fukuoka Financial Group announced a revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased its full-year dividend per share from 210 yen to 240 yen, primarily through a 30 yen increase in the year-end dividend from 105 yen to 135 yen. The interim dividend per share remains at 105 yen.

The revision reflects an upward adjustment of the full-year earnings forecast, based on mid-year results and current business performance trends. The company expects core banking profit at its subsidiary banks to grow more than previously anticipated, leading to higher consolidated net income attributable to parent company shareholders, which was revised upward by 13.0% from 100 billion yen to 113 billion yen.

With the new dividend level, the company targets a dividend payout ratio of approximately 40% for the fiscal year. This dividend increase is part of the company's earnings recovery and improved capital deployment strategy.
